categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `ci/test/` scripts to enable IPC in the i686 CI job.
categories.rationale: Enables IPC coverage on 32-bit x86 CI to catch compiler ABI issues. The commit message notes this exercises IPC on 32-bit x86 'where compiler ABI differences have caused failures', providing worthwhile platform test coverage without addressing an active release-blocking build failure.

categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and expands test matrix execution to cover IPC on 32-bit systems.
categories.rationale: Extends existing test suite execution to cover IPC under 32-bit x86. While primarily a CI configuration change, it closes a test coverage gap where 32-bit ABI differences previously went unexercised.
